The scene is filled with numerous players wearing white jerseys with dark lettering/numbers and dark caps. A central figure stands out wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and white pants, appearing to be a coach or manager addressing the seated players. The lighting is artificial and somewhat dim, creating shadows and lower contrast.
